description: Land Acquisition - Yapagama, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District and Ratmalgaha Ela, Dambulla D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels and servitudes for public purposes, including descriptions of land lots, their locations, extents, and claimant information. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" as defined in Type 4, specifically covering land acquisitions which is explicitly mentioned in the Land Gazette classification criteria.
